title: bureau.credit_balance.reported (CREDIT_BUREAU)
description: One event = one row of bureau_balance.csv (original column names and values are kept in payload). event_time: Same as bureau (same credit report); customer resolved via SK_ID_BUREAU -> bureau.

event_id.description: BLAKE2b-128 of source_table + natural key. Deterministic -> use it for de-duplication.

schema_version.description: SemVer. A MAJOR change -> new topic (.v2).

event_time.description: Business time (simulated, +07:00). Same as bureau (same credit report); customer resolved via SK_ID_BUREAU -> bureau.

produced_at.description: Wall-clock time the producer sent the event.

customer_id.description: SK_ID_CURR of the customer; also the Kafka message key.

MONTHS_BALANCE.description: Month of balance relative to application date (-1 means the freshest balance date)
MONTHS_BALANCE.x-note: time only relative to the application

STATUS.description: Status of Credit Bureau loan during the month (active, closed, DPD0-30,… [C means closed, X means status unknown, 0 means no DPD, 1 means maximal did during month between 1-30, 2 means DPD 31-60,… 5 means DPD 120+ or sold or written off ] )
